name: Publication Widget – Seonapsi
author: Raoul Gargiulo - Seonapsi

sections.description:
A lightweight WordPress dashboard widget that visualizes published posts per month in a bar chart.

Publication Widget – Seonapsi is a WordPress plugin that adds a dashboard widget displaying a bar chart of published articles per month.

Features:
* Displays a bar chart of published posts per month.
* Includes a year selector for viewing historical data.
* Uses Chart.js for rendering the graph.
* Fully responsive and lightweight.

Support

For support or feature requests, please visit https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/dashboard-publication-widget-seonapsi.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the publication-widget-seonapsi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The widget will automatically appear in the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the graph colors?

Not yet, but future updates may include customization options.

Does this plugin work with custom post types?

Currently, it only tracks standard posts (post post type).
